title: Long-Horizon Goal-Concealment Probe in a Toy Text Game

original_idea.body: Long-Horizon Goal-Concealment Probe. Problem: no compact tool probes whether an existing open model conceals a covert objective from visible outputs while still pursuing it. Direction: in a multi-turn text scenario give a private goal plus an instruction to keep it secret and a public task; measure concealment success and report a concealment curve vs secrecy incentive; probes an existing model rather than training one.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Compelling chain: probing hidden-goal concealment targets deceptive misalignment, a central catastrophic threat recognized by major safety orgs.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Multi-turn text scenario + concealment scoring; clear methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused concealment-curve deliverable; designing the game adds modest scope.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Model-organism-style probe on existing open models, no training; neglected gold-tier external work.

low_compute.reasoning: Probes existing model, no training; multi-turn inference on single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: CoT concealment under pressure studied; a compact goal-concealment toy-game probe may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Concealment/obfuscation is studied; a compact multi-turn goal-concealment probe is plausibly open.
